method: Weighted evidence-strength scoring; analyst judgment, not official rating or capability guarantee

criteria.name: Combined plumbing + drywall evidence
criteria.rule: 2 = company page explicitly advertises both plumbing and drywall/wall repair; 1 = active B + C-36 but drywall not explicitly advertised; 0 = C-36 only.
criteria.why: One-company preference is central, but a license class is not proof of job capability.

criteria.name: Occupied / multi-unit evidence
criteria.rule: 2 = independent third-party review explicitly describes an occupied/multi-unit property; 1 = company or search-index evidence advertises apartments/HOAs/property managers; 0 = no such evidence found.
criteria.why: Tenant-occupied delicate work requires protection, communication and references.

criteria.name: License / insurance / disclosure risk
criteria.rule: 2 = active C-36, workers compensation insured, no additional warning, license expiry more than 90 days away, and no workers-compensation policy expiry within 90 days; 1 = exempt/no employees, disclosure, near-term license/policy expiry, or other caution; 0 = future-suspension additional status.
criteria.why: CSLB status, bond, workers compensation and disclosures are official risk signals.

criteria.name: San Francisco service-area fit
criteria.rule: 2 = company explicitly serves San Francisco; 1 = SF address of record or surrounding-counties service only; 0 = service area not established/mismatched.
criteria.why: Address of record is not the same as confirmed service at the job address.

criteria.name: Review evidence quality
criteria.rule: 2 = directly read third-party platform with substantial reviews; 1 = search-index snippet or company-selected testimonial; 0 = no usable review evidence found.
criteria.why: Reviews are third-party evidence, never license verification.

criteria.name: Cost transparency
criteria.rule: 2 = published itemized price for this exact scope; 1 = owner-reported quote, published dispatch fee, or free-estimate policy; 0 = no cost evidence found.
criteria.why: No provider has published a verified combined price for this job.

candidates.name: Ace Plumbing & Rooter
candidates.reason: Strongest occupied-property evidence: BBB review from a family-run SF apartment building plus HOA/property-manager page; insured C-36/B. Drywall restoration is not explicitly advertised, so pair with a drywall specialist unless the company confirms scope.
candidates.limit: Drywall scope unconfirmed; no job quote.
candidates.cost_basis: Free estimates advertised; no job price published

candidates.name: Handyman Heroes Inc
candidates.reason: Explicitly advertises sheetrock/wall repairs plus plumbing for SF homes/apartments; B + C-36 and insured. Official complaint disclosure and a site C-10 claim absent from the CSLB record require review.
candidates.limit: CSLB disclosure; C-10 website claim not on record; Yelp blocked.
candidates.cost_basis: Free consultation advertised; no job price published

candidates.name: General SF
candidates.reason: Building page explicitly lists rough/finish plumbing and sheetrock/tape/texture; B + C-36. Best documented one-company scope, but workers compensation is exempt/no employees and review evidence is search-index only.
candidates.limit: WC exempt; no published cost; exact crew/coverage unconfirmed.

candidates.name: The Genteel Plumbers Inc
candidates.reason: Active B + C-36, insured, flat-rate pricing and published dispatch fee. Drywall is not advertised on the fetched page; company excludes the Financial District.
candidates.limit: Drywall unadvertised; service-area exclusion; workers-compensation policy expires 2027-01-24; Yelp snippet address/phone conflict.
candidates.cost_basis: $149 dispatch fee applied to services (company published); not a job quote

candidates.name: Rapid Flow Plumbing & Rooter Inc
candidates.reason: Active B + C-36; advertises plumbing plus general contracting/remodels and one crew. Drywall/ceiling restoration and occupied-unit references are not explicitly documented.
candidates.limit: WC exempt; drywall and occupied-unit evidence limited.
candidates.cost_basis: Free estimate advertised; no job price published

candidates.name: Fast Response Plumbing & Rooter
candidates.reason: Company advertises houses/apartments/HOAs, free per-job quotes and company-selected testimonials; active insured C-36. Owner-reported scope is adjustment only, and workers compensation policy expires 2026-12-18.
candidates.limit: Adjustment scope may not solve seized assembly; WC renewal check; review aggregate is company claim.

candidates.name: Expert Plumbing Solutions
candidates.reason: Owner reports a full waste-and-overflow quote; active insured C-36. C-36 only, so drywall would need a separately licensed partner unless scope is confirmed otherwise.
candidates.limit: Owner quote unverified; no drywall classification; no occupied-unit review evidence found.

candidates.name: Manny's Plumbing & Rooter
candidates.reason: Active C-36 + B; advertises tub install, drain replacement and kitchen/bath remodeling. Service wording is surrounding areas of San Mateo & San Francisco Counties; drywall/ceiling and occupied-unit evidence are limited.
candidates.limit: WC exempt; Daly City address; exact SF service and drywall scope unconfirmed.

candidates.name: Bay Area Plumbing
candidates.reason: Active C-36; advertises SF residential/commercial plumbing and leak/pipe repair. Owner-reported quote is a different diverter scope; workers compensation is exempt/no employees.
candidates.limit: Quote scope differs; WC exempt; no drywall classification.

candidates.name: Advanced Plumbing and Drain Inc
candidates.reason: Active C-36 and insured, but CSLB carries an additional status warning that the license may be suspended at a future date for an unresolved final liability. A similarly named website is a New Jersey business and is not matched.
candidates.limit: Future-suspension warning; identity mismatch; not recommended without resolution.

partner.name: Bernal Hill Drywall Inc
partner.role: Drywall specialist partner; not scored against plumbing candidates
